verdicts.reason: Both lose the hero: the Solstice can shrinks to a tiny icon in the bottom-left corner, the glow circle is cut off from it and clips the Shop Now button, and a large empty starfield panel takes up the middle. In A the can is still recognisable but the logo is pushed off-axis to the right of the left-aligned headline; in B the logo is centred, but the can breaks apart into two meaningless orange bars, so the product is gone completely.
